verdict.rationale: Logseq's local HTTP API server ships its own API documentation page at http://127.0.0.1:12315/. Its docs include worked curl examples, such as a POST to /api calling logseq.Editor.insertBlock, which run against the user's local graph. Nothing shows that the reference is interactive (try-it-out) or comes with a sandbox. The method reference itself (plugins-doc.logseq.com) is community-driven, and probes found no OpenAPI or llms.txt. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, an official first-party method reference, an OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, a sandbox environment, and independent corroboration.
